config.label: Your doc
config.description: Your doc.cheap API key. Without a key, the public sandbox key is used. It gives 10 free recognised documents per address in all, and at most 10 requests per address an hour, whatever their answer. Registering gives 100 free documents every month. The sandbox key has no balance.

config.label: Your doc
config.description: Your doc.cheap API key as `Bearer <key>`, for clients that leave `Authorization` free; `X-Doc-Cheap-Api-Key` wins when both are sent. Without a key, the public sandbox key is used. It gives 10 free recognised documents per address in all, and at most 10 requests per address an hour, whatever their answer. Registering gives 100 free documents every month.

config.label: Your doc
config.description: Your doc.cheap API key, for clients that reserve `Authorization` for their own use. It wins over `Authorization` when both are sent. Without a key, the public sandbox key is used. It gives 10 free recognised documents per address in all, and at most 10 requests per address an hour, whatever their answer. Registering gives 100 free documents every month.
